createBackup.dataDescription: Back up your application data with optional component selection. Typically 20-200 MB.
createBackup.fullDescription: Complete system: code, config, database, uploads, and all data. Deployable to a new machine.
createBackup.codeDescription: For distribution or fresh installs. Recipients run ./start.sh for a clean setup.
createBackup.title: Create Backup
createBackup.nameHelp: Custom name for the backup file (timestamp appended automatically)
createBackup.includePlugins: Include Plugins (scripts, configs — excludes models and datasets)

killSwitch.title: Emergency Kill Switch
killSwitch.warning: <bold>WARNING:</bold> This will forcefully terminate all active LLM processes. Use only when the system is unresponsive or consuming excessive resources.
killSwitch.overloadedAlert: System is currently overloaded. Consider using the kill switch.
killSwitch.statusHint: Click "Get System Status" to view current resource usage.
killSwitch.webAccessOff: Web access is now off: no tool, agent task or agent browser can reach outside sites. It stays off until you turn it back on in Settings.
killSwitch.webAccessFailed: Web access could not be turned off: {{error}}
killSwitch.agentTaskStopped: The running agent task was stopped.
killSwitch.confirmDescription: Force-terminates every model process. Any chat reply, generation or index job in flight is lost, and the next request will reload the model from scratch.

manageBackups.title: Manage Backups
manageBackups.emptyHint: Create a backup first to see it here

purgeIndex.title: Purge Index
purgeIndex.intro: Select which parts of the index to purge and optionally specify a date range.

reboot.waitingForOnline: Waiting for system to come back online...
reboot.maxPollingReached: Max polling time reached — checking health...
reboot.didNotComeBack: System did not come back online within the expected time.
reboot.title: System Reboot

restoreBackup.title: Restore Backup
